message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Generate a PoC (raw input file) for OSS-Fuzz issue 417113588 (haproxy): Heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in fuzz target fuzz_cfg_parser. Must submit via `bash ./submit.sh PATH_TO_POC /workspace/candidate_trace.json` with a fine trace JSON.

COMPLETED:
- Recovered from stuck `make` process (sleep 120 completed, shell unblocked)
- Confirmed ASAN-enabled haproxy binary exists at /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/haproxy/haproxy (17MB, ELF 64-bit, with debug_info)
- Re-read README.md, description.txt, submit.sh, fuzz_cfg_parser.c
- Examined parse_cfg() in src/cfgparse.c (line 1875), parse_line() in src/tools.c (line 6174), fgets_from_mem() in src/tools.c (line 7074)
- Analyzed EMIT_CHAR macro (line 6136) - writes to out[outpos] if outpos < outmax, sets PARSE_ERR_TOOLARGE otherwise
- Reviewed git history: commits 7e4a2f39e, 09a325a4d, 1f51f1c81 (parse_line empty-arg fixes)
- Identified potential overflow: `\x` hex escape in parse_line reads in[2]/in[3]; if `\x` is at end of buffer, in[3] reads past heap buffer (READ 1)

PENDING:
- Confirm exact trigger for heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 (likely `\x` at end of line filling buffer)
- Create PoC input file (>= 50 bytes) that triggers the overflow
- Create candidate_trace.json
- Submit via submit.sh

CURRENT_STATE:
- LINESIZE = 2048, buffer `thisline` malloc'd with linesize, realloc doubles on long lines
- parse_line called with outline=NULL, outlen=0 initially (PARSE_OPT_ENV|DQUOTE|SQUOTE|BKSLASH|SHARP|WORD_EXPAND)
- Key insight: line content can fill buffer to linesize-1 bytes (with \n at end, no realloc); `\x` at buf[linesize-3] would read in[3]=buf[linesize] past buffer
- Build directory: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/haproxy
- ASAN binary: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/haproxy/haproxy

CODE_STATE:
- Key files: src/cfgparse.c (parse_cfg at 1875), src/tools.c (parse_line at 6174, fgets_from_mem at 7074, EMIT_CHAR at 6136)
- Fuzzer: fuzz_cfg_parser.c calls parse_cfg() with data if size >= 50
- parse_line `\x` case: `if (!ishex(in[2]) || !ishex(in[3]))` - reads in[3] only if in[2] is hex

TESTS:
- No PoC tested yet
- ASAN build successful

CHANGES:
- None to source code

DEPS:
- gcc/g++ with ASAN
- haproxy source (v3.2-dev14)

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS:
- Branch: master, HEAD: 3bb6eea6d
- Recent commits: parse_line empty-arg fixes (7e4a2f39e, 09a325a4d, 1f51f1c81)
